metadata.description: Jonathan Dick's collection of portable, cross-agent skills for Claude Code, Copilot CLI, and friends.

plugins.name: skill-reflect
plugins.description: Session-based reflection on distributed skill performance, with explicit local-skill review support. Defaults to scrubbed findings in chat, writes a local report only when requested, and requires destination-specific authorization before filing any GitHub issue. Ships opt-in hooks that stage tiny local candidate markers (no AI, no network) and a maintainer skill for vendoring and drift checks.

plugins.name: app-stores
plugins.description: Take an app's store listing from one config to the App Store and Google Play: words per locale, store rules as dated and sourced data checked offline, fastlane-compatible output, a preview of each store's page, and a look-first send (plan, then apply exactly that plan); plus screenshots designed per store from real captures, every size and locale from one design, with drawn device frames and checks; and the captures themselves, taken at exactly each store's sizes on any stack (a screenshot mode, the DevFlow or Ailoha in-app agents, Appium, XCUITest, UI Automator, Maestro, simctl, adb, headless Chrome, or imported), with preview videos encoded to spec. Any app, any stack. Stdlib Python; network only when sending, only to the stores' own APIs; capture talks only to this machine.
